1.outline: Term theme: 'Web + AI Builders'. Learn the structure of a website — pages, navigation links and media — using Google Sites or basic HTML.
1.sowResources: Google Sites or a text editor, web-structure reference.
objectives: Explain the parts of a website: pages, links, media.
Plan a simple site structure.
Choose between Sites and HTML/CSS for the build.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Anatomy of a site
plan.detail: Explore an example site, labelling pages, navigation and media.

plan.title: Plan the structure
plan.detail: Sketch a simple sitemap for a chosen topic.

plan.title: Choose the tool
plan.detail: Decide: Google Sites for speed, or HTML/CSS for more control. Log out.

successCriteria: I can explain the parts of a website.
I planned a simple sitemap.
I chose a tool and can justify why.

2.outline: Learn basic HTML tags (headings, paragraphs, links) and simple CSS styling, or go deeper into Google Sites layout tools.
2.sowResources: Text editor / browser, or Google Sites, HTML/CSS cheat sheet.
objectives: Write basic HTML tags for headings, paragraphs and links.
Apply simple CSS styling.
Preview the page in a browser.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: First HTML tags
plan.detail:
Write

,

and tags in a simple text file and preview in the browser.

plan.title: Add CSS
plan.detail: Add simple CSS to change colour, font size or spacing.

plan.title: Preview and compare
plan.detail: Preview the styled page and compare with the unstyled version. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I wrote working heading, paragraph and link tags.
I applied at least one CSS style.
I previewed my page in a browser.

3.subtopic: A Site on a Chosen Topic
3.outline: Start building a small website on a chosen topic, applying the structure and styling learned this term.
objectives: Choose a topic for the site.
Build the first pages with structure and styling.
Follow the planned sitemap.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the site
plan.detail: Build the first 2-3 pages of the topic site, applying headings and styling.

plan.title: Check structure
plan.detail: Check the pages follow the sitemap plan. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I chose a clear topic for my site.
My first pages use headings and styling.
My pages follow my planned sitemap.

4.outline: Under teacher guidance, build a small tool or game related to the site's topic using an AI tool.
objectives: Use a guided AI tool to build a topic-related tool or game.
Test that it works.
Plan where it will sit on the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build with AI
plan.detail: Under supervision, use the guided AI tool to build a small tool or game related to the topic.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Test the tool works as expected.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: I built a tool or game related to my topic.
I tested that it works.
I planned where it fits on my site.

5.subtopic: Add the AI Creation to the Site
5.outline: Embed the AI-built tool into the website and check it works for a visitor.
objectives: Embed the AI tool into the site.
Check it works when accessed as a visitor would.
Add a short description.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Embed the tool
plan.detail: Embed the AI-built tool into a chosen page.

plan.title: Visitor test
plan.detail: Test it as a visitor would, without prior knowledge.

plan.title: Describe it
plan.detail: Write a short description of what the tool does. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My AI tool is embedded on the site.
It works when tested as a visitor.
It has a short description.

6.outline: Discuss Malaysian digital law basics (MCMC), AI bias, and privacy — one ethics issue relevant to the built site.
objectives: Explain what MCMC oversees in Malaysia.
Give an example of AI bias.
Discuss a privacy issue relevant to the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: MCMC basics
plan.detail: Introduce what MCMC (Malaysian Communications and Multimedia Commission) oversees, in age-appropriate terms.

plan.title: AI bias example
plan.detail: Discuss an example of AI bias and why it happens.

plan.title: Privacy discussion
plan.detail: Discuss one privacy issue relevant to the built site. Log out.

successCriteria: I can explain what MCMC oversees.
I can give an example of AI bias.
I discussed a privacy issue relevant to my site.

7.outline: Publish the site and review it against the ethics discussion — privacy, bias, honesty about AI use.
7.sowResources: Google Sites / HTML editor, ethics checklist.
objectives: Publish the finished site.
Review it against the ethics checklist.
Fix any issues found.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Ethics review
plan.detail: Check the site against the ethics checklist: privacy, AI credit, appropriate content.

plan.title: Publish
plan.detail: Fix any issues and publish the site.

plan.title: Peer check
plan.detail: A partner visits the published site to confirm it works. Log out.

successCriteria: I checked my site against the ethics checklist.
My site is published correctly.
A partner confirmed my published site works.

8.outline: Present the finished site and AI tool to the class, including a short reflection on the ethics issue discussed.
objectives: Present the finished site and AI tool.
Reflect on one ethics issue discussed this term.
Save the site to the portfolio.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Present the build
plan.detail: Present the site and demo the AI tool to the class.

plan.title: Ethics reflection
plan.detail: Give a short reflection on one ethics issue relevant to the build.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the site link to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished site and AI tool.
I gave a short reflection on one ethics issue.
My site link is saved to the portfolio folder.

9.outline: Extend the site with a third page, applying feedback received during the presentation.
objectives: Add a third page to the site.
Apply at least one piece of feedback.
Re-publish the site.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add a page
plan.detail: Add a third page and apply at least one piece of presentation feedback.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish and check the new page appears correctly.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save and log out.

successCriteria: My site now has a third page.
I applied at least one piece of feedback.
My re-published site works correctly.

10.outline: Rehearse the term's web and AI skills in pairs: structure a page, style it, embed a tool, publish.
10.sowResources: Recap slide deck, practice task cards.
objectives: Recall the term's web-building process in order.
Rehearse building and publishing a page with a partner.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Process recap
plan.detail: Recap: structure, HTML/CSS or Sites, AI tool, ethics, publish — as a class chant.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build and publish a short page with a partner reading the task card, then swap.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I can list the term's process in order.
I rehearsed the practical task with a partner.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: publish a site with an AI-built tool/game and a short written reflection on one ethics issue.
objectives: Structure and publish a working site.
Embed an AI-built tool/game.
Write a short reflection on one ethics issue.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Build the site
plan.detail: Individual practical: structure and build pages, embed the AI tool.

plan.title: Publish and reflect
plan.detail: Publish the site and write the ethics reflection.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My site is structured and published.
My AI-built tool/game is embedded and works.
My ethics reflection is clear and relevant.

12.outline: Plan a final, polished version of the site with a fourth page and a more advanced AI-built feature.
objectives: Plan a fourth page and an advanced AI feature.
Sketch how it fits the existing site.
Consider ethics implications of the new feature.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Plan the extension
plan.detail: Plan a fourth page and a more advanced AI feature, considering ethics.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan adds a fourth page and an AI feature.
My plan considers one ethics implication.
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.outline: Build the fourth page and the advanced AI feature, following the plan.
13.sowResources: Google Sites / HTML editor, teacher-guided AI tool.
objectives: Build the fourth page.
Build and embed the advanced AI feature.
Test everything works together.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the extension
plan.detail: Build the fourth page and the advanced AI feature, embedding it correctly.

plan.title: Test it
plan.detail: Test the whole site works together. Save and log out.

activities: Build and embed the AI feature
successCriteria: My site now has four pages.
My advanced AI feature is embedded and works.
My whole site works together correctly.

14.outline: Final ethics and privacy check, re-publish the extended site, and rehearse presenting it.
14.sowResources: Google Sites / HTML editor, ethics checklist.
objectives: Do a final ethics and privacy check.
Re-publish the extended site.
Rehearse presenting it.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Final check
plan.detail: Check the whole site against the ethics checklist one more time.

plan.title: Re-publish
plan.detail: Re-publish the extended site.

plan.title: Rehearse
plan.detail: Practise presenting the full site to a partner. Log out.

successCriteria: My site passed a final ethics check.
My extended site is re-published.
I rehearsed presenting it to a partner.

15.outline: Present the finished, extended site to the class as a 'Web Builders Fair', and save the whole year's portfolio.
objectives: Present the finished site confidently.
Demo the AI features and explain the ethics considerations.
Save the whole year's portfolio.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Web Builders Fair
plan.detail: Present sites to the class in small groups.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished site and review the whole year's portfolio folder.

plan.title: Year celebration
plan.detail: Name three things learned this year. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my finished site confidently.
I demoed the AI features and explained the ethics considerations.
My whole year's work is saved in the portfolio.
